analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure the UI functions correctly after a frontend patch by conducting a start-run smoke test.
requirements_understanding: The objective is to verify UI stability and functionality post-patch.
A smoke test should cover critical UI components to ensure no major issues are introduced.
The test should be automated to ensure consistency and repeatability.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement automated UI smoke tests using a testing framework like Selenium or Cypress.
Ensure tests cover key UI workflows and components.
Integrate tests into the CI/CD pipeline to run after each frontend patch deployment.
clarifications_requested: What specific UI components or workflows are considered critical for the smoke test?
Are there any existing test scripts or frameworks in use that should be leveraged?

output.executive_summary: Automate UI smoke tests to ensure frontend stability after patches, integrating them into the CI/CD pipeline for consistent validation.

functional_requirements.title: Automated UI Smoke Test Execution

project.name: UI Smoke Test Automation
project.objective: Ensure the UI functions correctly after a frontend patch by conducting a start-run smoke test.

at_a_glance.readiness_delta_note: Score is weighted by discovered risk/blocker density (risks=0, high_severity=0, failed_review_checks=1) and extraction coverage. Lower scores across runs usually indicate improved detection coverage, not model instability.
at_a_glance.headline: Phased modernization recommended.

recommended_strategy.name: Phased modernization
recommended_strategy.rationale: Preserve behavior first, then modernize in controlled phases.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure the UI functions correctly after a frontend patch by conducting a start-run smoke test.
requirements_understanding: The objective is to verify UI stability and functionality post-patch.
A smoke test should cover critical UI components to ensure no major issues are introduced.
The test should be automated to ensure consistency and repeatability.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement automated UI smoke tests using a testing framework like Selenium or Cypress.
Ensure tests cover key UI workflows and components.
Integrate tests into the CI/CD pipeline to run after each frontend patch deployment.
clarifications_requested: What specific UI components or workflows are considered critical for the smoke test?

at_a_glance.readiness_delta_note: Score is weighted by discovered risk/blocker density (risks=0, high_severity=0, failed_review_checks=1) and extraction coverage. Lower scores across runs usually indicate improved detection coverage, not model instability.
at_a_glance.headline: Phased modernization recommended.

recommended_strategy.name: Phased modernization
recommended_strategy.rationale: Preserve behavior first, then modernize in controlled phases.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
